text.p: Italian Btp bond futures ended firmer, helped by particularly by Bonds and supported by hopes of a near-term cut in the Bank of Italy's key discount rate.
The June Liffe Btp contract ended 99 basis points higher at 128.83 after touching a session high of 128.94, with the next test seen at 129.00/05.

"The market is currently buoyed quite a bit by expectations of an eventual Bank of Italy rate cut," one dealer said. "This morning Milan was moderately positive but once we broke 128.65 many investors who'd been sidelined came in for fear of missing the train," another trader said.
